description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M). Change qk_lut shape (NAP=4, tph=256) -> (NAP=6, tph=128). NOT param-matched: 6*256*16*128=3.15M -> 6*128*64*128=6.29M per layer. qk_lut size doubles, total +18.87M -> ~119.5M total. Tests larger-than-baseline qk capacity. exp700 (NAP=6,tph=64 param-matched deep) was net-negative; this exp keeps NAP=6 but adds more tables for capacity. Refs: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M, exp700 (killed step 4400)=1.5036 (vs exp696 1.4953, +8 mb).
